fairness.title: Provably Fair
fairness.subtitle: Every unbox result is determined by the server seed, your client seed and a nonce. The SHA-256 hash of the server seed is published before opening; once the seed is revealed, anyone can reproduce the exact result.
fairness.formula: roll = first 8 hex chars of HMAC-SHA256(server seed, client seed:nonce) → integer → mod {range}
fairness.step1: Before opening, we publish the SHA-256 hash of the server seed.
fairness.step2: You choose a client seed or receive a random one. The nonce increments by 1 per open.
fairness.step3: After opening, the server seed is revealed. Paste it below and the hash, roll and winning item are reproduced exactly.
fairness.hashMismatch: Does not match the published hash — different server seed
fairness.tryBody: Generate a server seed and only its hash is shown. Reveal it, then paste it into the verifier to reproduce a roll.
fairness.invalidInput: Enter a server seed and a client seed; the nonce must be an integer ≥ 0.

footer.slogan: The most transparent blockchain-based luxury mystery box platform for real goods
footer.disclaimer: VOILA is a global e-commerce mystery box platform. Every opening result is published transparently through a tamper-proof SHA-256 algorithm, and every winning item is guaranteed to ship free as a genuine physical product or to pay back 95% instantly.

sections.p: VOILA sells mystery boxes with fully published odds and either ships the winning item or cashes it out instantly at 95% of market value in USDT.
Balances are held in USDT. Top-ups, withdrawals, openings and paybacks are recorded as transactions and used for nothing other than purchases and withdrawals.
Every box publishes its per-item odds before opening. Results are fixed by a server seed hash published in advance and the user's client seed, and anyone can reproduce and verify them.
A box cannot be cancelled once opening starts. Any winning item can be sold back at 95% or shipped at any time.
Users are responsible for complying with local law. In case of a service failure balances are restored from the transaction record.

Recipient name, phone, address and customs identifier for shipping; wallet address for withdrawals; transaction identifiers for payments. Card details are handled by the payment processor and never stored by us.
Only for shipping, withdrawals, fraud prevention and support.
Kept for the period required by law after shipping or withdrawal completes, then deleted without delay.
Only the minimum needed is shared with carriers (shipping) and payment processors (payments).
You can request access, correction or deletion at any time through support.
Any item in your vault pays back 95% of market value in USDT right away, credited to your balance immediately.

International shipping is deducted from your balance on request; destination duties and VAT are paid on delivery. Korea ships via CJ Logistics, international via DHL/FedEx, and the tracking number appears in your vault once issued.
USDT withdrawals run on TRC-20 (1.00 USDT fee) or BEP-20 (0.80 USDT fee) with a 20 USDT minimum. The TxID and explorer link are provided after broadcast.
The lowest item in every box pays back at least 80% of the box price.

sections.h: Can I really start with 1 USDT?
sections.p: Yes. The $1 category opens for 1.00 USDT, and even a miss returns 0.85 USDT instantly.

sections.h: How do I know a result wasn't rigged?
sections.p: Press the 1-second fairness check on any result or vault card. It replays the pre-committed hash, the roll number and the bracket match in three steps.

sections.h: Can I take cash instead of the item?
sections.p: Any time — take 95% of market value back as USDT from your vault.
They are broadcast after a security review; the TxID and TronScan/BscScan link appear once complete.
